cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.2.3.0)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "")
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS " -mcpu=cortex-m3  -Wall -fdata-sections -ffunction-sections -fstack-usage -mcpu=cortex-m3  -Wall -fdata-sections -ffunction-sections -fstack-usage")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-O0 -g3")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "-mcpu=cortex-m3  -T \"C:/Users/ROG/Desktop/工作/FPGA工作空间/26-FPGA-Pango/mcu/firmware/yuntai/STM32F103XX_FLASH.ld\" --specs=nano.specs -Wl,-Map=yuntai.map -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--print-memory-usage")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-v]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "C:/Users/ROG/Desktop/工作/FPGA工作空间/26-FPGA-Pango/mcu/build/f1/Release/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-cexss3")
add_library(cmTC_6bd3a STATIC)
target_sources(cmTC_6bd3a PRIVATE
  "C:/Users/ROG/AppData/Local/stm32cube/bundles/cmake/4.2.3+st.1/share/cmake-4.2/Modules/CMakeCCompilerABI.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_6bd3a_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_6bd3a>)
set_property(TARGET cmTC_6bd3a PROPERTY "C_EXTENSIONS" "ON")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_6bd3a PROPERTY "C_STANDARD" "11")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_6bd3a PROPERTY "C_STANDARD_REQUIRED" "ON")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_6bd3a ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
